answer: A payout is split so that 48% arrives at settlement and the rest over 9 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The mesa schedule is applied in hollow and vault exposes each instalment. An adversary therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2886 identities would post 3084 proofs and burn roughly 82 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
